description: The line plot illustrates the performance of three different methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—measured by accuracy (in Pass@100) as a function of temperature, with the title indicating the performance is evaluated "w.r.t. Temperature." The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," spans from 0.1 to 1.0 on a linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@100)," ranges from 62.5 to 80.0, also on a linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The legend identifies three distinct lines: On-policy RL is represented by a yellow line with circular markers; LUFFY is shown as a red line with star-shaped markers; and SFT is depicted as a teal line with downward-pointing triangular markers. The On-policy RL line starts at an accuracy of approximately 65.0 at a temperature of 0.1, rises to a peak of about 79.0 at a temperature of 0.6, and then declines to around 75.0 at a temperature of 0.8. The LUFFY line begins at an accuracy of approximately 76.5 at a temperature of 0.1, fluctuates with a peak near 81.0 at a temperature of 0.7, and ends at about 79.0 at a temperature of 0.8. The SFT line starts at an accuracy of approximately 76.5 at a temperature of 0.1, shows a general downward trend with a significant dip to about 72.0 at a temperature of 0.4, and then rises to a peak of approximately 80.0 at a temperature of 0.5 before declining to around 76.0 at a temperature of 0.8.
